recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-18837 unless a future work-group decision changes the ServiceRequest.subject model or short description.
issue_request: FHIR-18837 was a Published FHIR-core-ServiceRequest change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for STU3, asking that the ServiceRequest.subject short description stop saying only "Individual" because the subject reference can target Patient, Group, Location, and Device. The approved resolution was to change the wording to "Individual or Entity...".
initial_application: The Jira comment cites commit a09f8c740b6273d05dba437043a1ff1464fa2970, which changed the old source/servicerequest/servicerequest-spreadsheet.xml short text from "Individual the service is ordered for" to "Individual or Entity the service is ordered for". Later source refactors, including 33b409a4b6 and c69d71aa21, preserved that wording in source/servicerequest/structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml.
additional_context: ServiceRequest is active in the current build via source/fhir.ini. The authoritative StructureDefinition source now has ServiceRequest.subject short="Individual or Entity the service is ordered for" and still lists Patient, Group, Location, and Device target profiles; the mapping exception file also records the same ServiceRequest-specific short. No directly relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that changes this conclusion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current in-scope source already reflects the final Jira disposition, and a source edit would be redundant rather than corrective.
